notes: First-reader proposal for root adjudication; no final-page status asserted. Whole source image viewed once for layout, each half once line by line against C and H, followed by saved crops. No OCR, web, outside page or TeX compilation used.

Line_count=27 counts the twenty-seven main source baselines, including displays at L13, L22 and L25. Interlinear and marginal material is inventoried separately. There is no authorial heading/page number; pencilled archive number 16 is a comment.

Original scan dimensions 1668×2143. Boxes are full-scan original pixels. Crops use LANCZOS enlargement to approximately 2500 pixels on the long edge, autocontrast and mild unsharp masking. b04 is rotated clockwise 37 degrees to display the slanted margin upright.

Content: continuation of the description of Dynkin pairs and centralizers, open subsets in degree two, the subgroups P,U,L, and two adjoint-orbit maps. These topics orient the reading only; no mathematical proof or correctness verdict is supplied.

Source slips and intermediate states are preserved: Bour, satisfasse with cancelled nt, i.e; and the uncertain Celui+ci connector. The a/u and A/D type-over proposals retain uncertainty on the overwritten letters.
The initial cancelled parenthetical note is an insertion with a visible attachment to the position after unipotent. Its c/subset-shaped sign plus capital U is not expanded to celui.
The margin has a wavy upper relation stroke (≃); its small Z subscript remains o|0. The cancelled Commut- word is not made certain.

The degree-two notation occurs twice in the (iii) paragraph: a heavily cancelled tentative formula after dense, then a clear live g(2)* after l’ouvert. H’s editorial claim of a cancelled ≠0 is retained as a possible reading of the first cancellation, not as an extra source item above éléments.
The cancelled Fil^1(g) formula has both inner mathematical parentheses and outer prose parentheses. H and C lose different pairs.
In f:S?(2,k)→G the second letter is crowded and is left SZ|Sl. The expected group name does not settle the ink.
All visible insertions and cancellations were audited. No mathematical diagram or drawing occurs. There are only insertion rules and cancellation strokes.
Purely visual inspections are under visual_audit_events. check_events is empty because this reading performed no actual proof, calculation or formal certificate.

Page-specific prior_questions.md was read after the report was drafted and crosschecked: every listed doubt/slip is covered by the existing crops and decisions. No additional image viewing was needed.

The live affine expression a+g^e is preserved exactly. It is not replaced by a+Lie(Z^+) to harmonize it with the revised centralizer expression above; any mathematical question about that source expression is left for later discussion.

The capital G in G_m is typed and separately underlined, retained as \underline G_m.
The two displayed arrows g↦ad(g).x and g↦ad(g).e both have left-hand bars and right arrowheads. The inline arrows in i:G_m→G and the adjoint map have no left bars.
The symbols following g(2) at the live insertion and in the final two lines are stars; the two final Fil exponents are handwritten 3.
Keep the source abbreviations cf, NB and i.e.; the particular occurrence in L17 is typed i.e; with a semicolon. Do not regularize it.
